description: Mainnet Era ChainAdmin: multicall → ProxyAdmin(0x257fc0c3…).upgrade(existing Era ServerNotifier proxy 0xfca808a7…, newImpl). IN-PLACE ServerNotifier upgrade — proxy address stays stable, off-chain server config doesn't change. (Era ServerNotifier ownership is already the ChainAdmin, so no acceptOwnership is folded in.)

Atlas ChainAdmin: multicall → ProxyAdmin(0xe5f57E87…).upgrade(ServerNotifier proxy 0xBfaa7332…, newImpl). IN-PLACE ServerNotifier upgrade — proxy address stays stable, off-chain server config doesn't need to change.
Mainnet legacy Gov: scheduleTransparent — queues Atlas GovernanceUpgradeTimer.transferOwnership(PUH). PUH accepts in stage 0.
Mainnet legacy Gov: execute — runs the scheduled Atlas GovernanceUpgradeTimer.transferOwnership(PUH) now, called by the EOA owner (delay 0). PUH accepts in stage 0.
Mainnet PUH stage 0/1: ChainAssetHandler.pauseMigration() — freezes cross-chain migrations during the upgrade window (re-asserted unconditionally at the head of stage 1).
Mainnet PUH stage 0: Era GovernanceUpgradeTimer.startTimer() — starts the Era-side deadline; stage 1 checkDeadline() asserts against it.
Mainnet PUH stage 0: Atlas (ZKsync OS) GovernanceUpgradeTimer.startTimer() — starts the Atlas-side deadline.

Mainnet PUH stage 0: PUH ProxyAdmin.upgradeAndCall(PUH proxy 0xE30Dca30…, newImpl, initialize(security_council, guardians, emergency_upgrade_board)) — upgrades the ProtocolUpgradeHandler proxy itself (PUH/Guardians redeploy).
Mainnet PUH stage 0: Atlas CTM.acceptOwnership() — completes the Ownable2Step transfer queued via the legacy-Gov ceremony; PUH now owns the Atlas CTM.
Mainnet PUH stage 0: Atlas ValidatorTimelock.acceptOwnership() — completes the legacy-Gov transfer to PUH.
Mainnet PUH stage 0: L1AssetTracker.acceptOwnership() — completes the deployer-issued transferOwnership(PUH); PUH owns the L1AssetTracker.
Mainnet PUH stage 0: ChainRegistrationSender.acceptOwnership() — completes the deployer-issued transferOwnership(PUH); PUH owns ChainRegistrationSender.

Mainnet PUH stage 0: Era RollupDAManager.acceptOwnership() — completes the deployer-issued transfer to PUH. The v31-redeployed manager already has the rollup DA pair registered at deploy time, so no governance updateDAPair() call is needed.
Mainnet PUH stage 0: Atlas GovernanceUpgradeTimer.acceptOwnership() — completes the legacy-Gov transfer to PUH.
Mainnet PUH stage 0: Atlas RollupDAManager.acceptOwnership() — completes the legacy-Gov transfer to PUH.
Mainnet PUH stage 0: Atlas (ZKsync OS) verifier.acceptOwnership() — completes the deployer-issued verifier transfer to PUH.
Mainnet PUH stage 0/1: ChainAssetHandler.pauseMigration() — freezes cross-chain migrations during the upgrade window (re-asserted unconditionally at the head of stage 1).
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgrade(Bridgehub 0x303a465b…, newImpl) — swaps Bridgehub impl to v31.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgrade(L1Nullifier 0xd7f9f541…, newImpl) — swaps L1Nullifier impl to v31.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgrade(L1AssetRouter 0x8829ad80…, newImpl) — swaps L1AssetRouter impl to v31.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgrade(NativeTokenVault 0xbed1eb54…, newImpl) — swaps NTV impl to v31.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgradeAndCall(MessageRoot 0x5ce92577…, newImpl, initData) — swaps MessageRoot impl + runs the v31 reinitializer.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgrade(CTMDeploymentTracker 0x6078f6b3…, newImpl) — swaps CTMDeploymentTracker impl to v31.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgrade(ChainAssetHandler 0xdd5cb8b9…, newImpl) — swaps ChainAssetHandler impl to v31.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: NTV.setAssetTracker(L1AssetTracker 0x8ef17384…) — wires NTV to push balance updates to the L1AT.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Bridgehub.setAddressesV31(ChainRegistrationSender 0x7f60f575…) — wires Bridgehub to the v31 ChainRegistrationSender.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ChainAssetHandler.setAddresses(...) — post-upgrade pointer fixups (bridgehub / AR / AT / etc.).
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Era GovernanceUpgradeTimer.checkDeadline() — asserts the stage-0 Era deadline window has elapsed (sim injects evm_increaseTime).
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Era UpgradeStageValidator.checkMigrationsPaused() — sanity: stage-0 pauseMigration took effect for Era chains.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgrade(Era CTM 0xc2ee6b6a…, newImpl) — swaps the Era CTM impl to v31.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Era CTM.setChainCreationParams(...) — sets v31 chain-creation params (bootloader, defaultAA, genesis, evmEmulator) for Era chains.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Era CTM.setNewVersionUpgrade(diamondCut, oldVer, oldEnd, newVer) — registers the v31 upgrade hash on the Era CTM.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: ecosystem TPA.upgrade(Era ValidatorTimelock 0x2e5110cf…, newImpl) — swaps the Era ValidatorTimelock impl to v31.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Atlas GovernanceUpgradeTimer.checkDeadline() — Atlas-side deadline check.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Atlas UpgradeStageValidator.checkMigrationsPaused() — sanity check for Atlas chains.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Atlas CTM ProxyAdmin.upgrade(Atlas CTM 0x1adf137f…, newImpl). PUH owns this PA now (bundle 5 + stage-0 acceptOwnership set it up).
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Atlas CTM.setChainCreationParams(...) — sets v31 chain-creation params for Atlas (ZKsync OS) chains.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Atlas CTM.setNewVersionUpgrade(...) — registers the v31 upgrade hash on the Atlas CTM.
Mainnet PUH stage 1: Atlas CTM ProxyAdmin.upgrade(Atlas ValidatorTimelock 0x18cc3817…, newImpl) — swaps the Atlas ValidatorTimelock impl to v31.

Mainnet PUH stage 2 (legacy GW decommission): ChainAssetHandler.setHistoricalMigrationInterval(chainId 324, migrationNumber, interval{settlementLayerChainId=9075, ...}) — backfills the historical migration interval for Era chain 324 that round-tripped through the legacy Gateway (chain 9075), so its migration history is retained under the new asset-handler.

Mainnet PUH stage 2 (legacy GW decommission): Bridgehub.setSettlementLayerStatus(legacy GW chain 9075, false) — blacklists the legacy Gateway chain as a settlement layer so chains can't migrate back to it. Final call of the decommission sequence.
Mainnet PUH stage 2: ChainAssetHandler.unpauseMigration() — re-enables cross-chain migrations now that all impls are swapped.
Mainnet PUH stage 2: Era UpgradeStageValidator.checkProtocolUpgradePresence() — sanity: v31 upgrade hash registered on every Era chain.
Mainnet PUH stage 2: Era UpgradeStageValidator.checkMigrationsUnpaused() — sanity: migrations unpaused for Era chains.
Mainnet PUH stage 2: Atlas UpgradeStageValidator.checkProtocolUpgradePresence() — sanity for Atlas (ZKsync OS) chains.
Mainnet PUH stage 2: Atlas UpgradeStageValidator.checkMigrationsUnpaused() — sanity for Atlas chains.
Mainnet test (post-upgrade smoke): Bridgehub.createNewChain(chainId 555, Era CTM) — verifies a fresh Era chain can be created on the v31 protocol version.
Mainnet test (post-upgrade smoke): Bridgehub.createNewChain(chainId 556, Atlas/ZKsync OS CTM) — verifies a fresh ZKsync OS chain can be created on v31.
Mainnet test (post-upgrade smoke): upgrade the real Era chain 324 (upgradeChainFromVersion) — verifies the upgrade path for the existing Era chain.
Mainnet test (post-upgrade smoke): upgrade an existing Atlas (ZKsync OS) chain (upgradeChainFromVersion) — verifies the upgrade path for the existing ZKsync OS chain.
